title: Unbounded memory growth via EVM Error message allocations
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  In `executor.rs`, the EVM error handling code creates permanent memory allocations for each unique error value through the use of `Box::leak`.
